mapper.select: SELECT a.`INDEX_ID` AS id, a.`INDEX_NAME` AS `text`, a.`PARENT_ID` AS pId FROM `indicators_lib`.`lib_index_relation` a WHERE a.`IS_FINAL` = '1'

SELECT COUNT(V.INDEX_DIMNSN) AS REPEAT_COUNT,V.INDEX_DIMNSN, CASE WHEN V.INDEX_DIMNSN=1 THEN '国库' WHEN V.INDEX_DIMNSN=2 THEN '地区' ELSE '' END INDEX_DIMNSN_DSCR FROM( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.INDEX_DIMNSN, ',', b.help_topic_id + 1 ), ',',- 1) INDEX_DIMNSN FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a JOIN mysql.help_topic b ON b.help_topic_id < (LENGTH(a.INDEX_DIMNSN) - LENGTH(REPLACE(a.INDEX_DIMNSN, ',', '' )) + 1) WHERE (a.INDEX_DIMNSN <> '' OR a.INDEX_DIMNSN IS NOT NULL)
AND a.INDEX_ID IN
#{inedxId}
ORDER BY INDEX_DIMNSN ) V GROUP BY INDEX_DIMNSN
HAVING REPEAT_COUNT > 1

SELECT COUNT(V.INDEX_PERIOD) AS REPEAT_COUNT,V.INDEX_PERIOD, CASE WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=1 THEN '日' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=2 THEN '月' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=3 THEN '季' WHEN V.INDEX_PERIOD=4 THEN '年' ELSE '' END INDEX_PERIOD_DSCR FROM( SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.INDEX_PERIOD, ',', b.help_topic_id + 1 ), ',',- 1) INDEX_PERIOD FROM indicators_lib.lib_index_relation a JOIN mysql.help_topic b ON b.help_topic_id < (LENGTH(a.INDEX_PERIOD) - LENGTH(REPLACE(a.INDEX_PERIOD, ',', '' )) + 1) WHERE (a.INDEX_PERIOD <> '' OR a.INDEX_DIMNSN IS NOT NULL)
AND a.INDEX_ID IN
#{inedxId}
ORDER BY INDEX_PERIOD ) V GROUP BY INDEX_PERIOD
HAVING REPEAT_COUNT > 1
mapper.update: UPDATE indicators_lib.`lib_index_relation` SET INDEX_STATUS='1' WHERE INDEX_ID=#{params.INDEX_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(a.IDENTITY_PROPERTY) AS SEQ FROM `indicators_lib`.`lib_index_relation` a

SELECT * FROM `indicators_lib`.`lib_index_relation` a WHERE 1=1
AND a.`INDEX_ID` = #{params.INDEX_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE indicators_lib.`lib_index_relation` SET INDEX_NAME = #{params.INDEX_NAME}, INDEX_DESCR = #{params.INDEX_DESCR}, INDEX_DETAILS = #{params.INDEX_DETAILS}, MODIFY_USERID = #{params.MODIFY_USERID}, MODIFY_DATE = #{params.MODIFY_DATE} WHERE INDEX_ID=#{params.INDEX_ID}

UPDATE `indicators_lib`.`lib_index_formula` SET ORIGINAL_DSCR = #{params.ORIGINAL_DSCR}, ORIGINAL_DSCR_ARRY = #{params.ORIGINAL_DSCR_ARRY}, INDEX_DSCR = #{params.INDEX_DSCR}, INDEX_DSCR_ARRY = #{params.INDEX_DSCR_ARRY}, EXE_SQL = #{params.EXE_SQL}, EXE_WHERE = #{params.EXE_WHERE}, MODIFY_DATE = #{params.MODIFY_DATE}, MODIFY_USERID = #{params.MODIFY_USERID}, HTML_STR = #{params.HTML_STR} WHERE ID = #{params.INDEX_ID}
mapper.select: CREATE TABLE `indicators_lib`.${params.INDEX_CORRE_TABLE} ( `INDEX_ID` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '指标id', `ACCOUNT_PERIOD` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '账期', `INDEX_DIM_CODE` varchar(12) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '指标维度编码', `INDEX_DIM_DESCR` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '指标维度描述', `DIMENSION_FLAG` varchar(2) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '维度标识(1国库，2地区，3核算主体)', `PERIOD_FLAG` varchar(2) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '周期标识(1日，2月，3季，4年)', `INDEX_VALUE` decimal(28,2) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '指标值', `ADD_USERID` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新增人ID', `ADD_DATE` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '新增时间', `MODIFY_USERID` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '修改人ID', `MODIFY_DATE` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '修改时间' ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='${params.INDEX_NAME}'
